I have successfully prevented VLC Media Player from auto-closing after videos end. 

**Solution:**

The issue was resolved by ensuring the **'Play and exit'** option is unchecked in VLC's Playlist settings.

**Steps taken:**

1. Opened VLC Media Player
2. Accessed **Tools > Preferences**
3. Switched to **All** (Advanced) settings mode
4. Navigated to **Interface > Main interfaces > Qt**
5. Located the **Playlist** settings in the tree view
6. Verified that the **'Play and exit'** checkbox is **unchecked**
7. Saved the preferences
8. Reopened Preferences to confirm the setting was correctly saved

**Result:**

The 'Play and exit' setting being unchecked means VLC will continue running and remain open even after a video finishes playing. This setting controls whether VLC automatically closes when playback ends. With this option disabled, VLC will stay open allowing you to continue using the application or load additional content.

The configuration has been verified and saved. VLC Media Player is now configured to prevent auto-closing after videos end.
